title: Pan-Seared Wagyu Luscious Bowl
description: A hearty bowl dish featuring pan-seared Wagyu beef, served with a side of Norwegian luscious vegetables.

ingredients.name: Norwegian luscious vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as asparagus or bell peppers

ingredients.name: cooking oil
ingredients.notes: such as sesame or avocado oil

instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the Wagyu beef with salt, pepper, and a pinch of sugar.
Sear the beef in the skillet for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 130°F for medium-rare.
Transfer the beef to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, ginger, and garlic to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the Norwegian luscious vegetables to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they are tender.
Slice the Wagyu beef against the grain and serve it on top of the vegetables.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
